ios.desc:
Built out of a genuine love for learning Chinese, Wen Reader gives intermediate readers a clean, modern way to read native-level books while getting context-aware dictionary definitions with a simple long-press.

Import your own EPUBs, read with great typography, and stay fully offline.

Features:
- EPUB Import & Smooth Reading: open standard EPUB files from Files, with fast pagination powered by Readium and adjustable margins, fonts, and line spacing.
- Instant Dictionary Pop-Ups: long-press any Chinese text to see an inline definition panel using offline CC-CEDICT data.
- Lightweight On-Device ML: context-aware word boundary segmentation and dictionary definition ranking.
- Context & Sharing Tools: quickly copy the selected word, sentence, or paragraph, or send text to Pleco or ChatGPT (when installed) for deeper explanation.
- Simple, Focused Navigation: tap the book title to browse the table of contents, and Wen Reader automatically saves your reading position as you go.

Who is Wen Reader For?
- Readers who can understand native Chinese text with some effort.
- Learners who want a modern, clean EPUB reading experience without distractions.
- Users who benefit from quick dictionary support but do not need the full ecosystem of flashcards, handwriting input, OCR, etc.

Privacy
- No analytics, no tracking, and no personal data collection. 
- No external API calls.
- Everything stays on your device.

Open Source & Licenses
- Wen Reader uses open dictionary, models, and library components. 
- Full license information is available inside the app under About → Licenses.

Support
- Questions, suggestions, or feedback? Feel free to contact me at oliverzh2000@gmail.com. Or visit github.com/oliverzh2000/wen-reader to open an issue.

show_hn.title: Show HN: An open-source Chinese ePub reader iOS app with pop-up dictionary

quotes.text:
Hi HN!

I originally built this app for myself because, as an intermediate Chinese learner, I wanted a clean EPUB reader with fast, offline pop-up dictionary support.

As a small thank-you to the Chinese learning community, I decided to make it a free and open-source iOS app.

Main features:
- Import your own EPUBs

- Long-press any Chinese text to get an inline dictionary definition

- Option to copy the word, sentence, or paragraph, or send text to Pleco / ChatGPT (if installed)

- Everything works fully offline and the app collects no data

I’m mainly trying to figure out whether this kind of pop-up dictionary EPUB reading workflow is actually useful for people who read Chinese regularly, so any honest feedback (good or bad) would be super helpful!

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/ca/app/wen-reader/id6755988730

GitHub: https://github.com/oliverzh2000/wen-reader

Happy to answer questions or dive into implementation details.
